projects.name: StayEase — Hotel Booking System

image.alt: StayEase hotel booking site shown on desktop and mobile, with the availability search, a booking confirmation and the reports panel

projects.description: A booking and operations platform for a single hotel. Guests browse rooms, check live availability, and book and pay online or at the hotel. Receptionists run the front desk, and administrators manage rooms, reservations, payments, promotions, reviews and reports.
highlights: Race-safe availability: row locks inside a transaction, verified by tests where 8 simultaneous requests for 2 rooms yield exactly 2 bookings
Server-side sessions, CSRF tokens, role- and permission-based access, Helmet CSP, rate limiting and zod validation
PayMongo payments (GCash, Maya, cards), Brevo email and Cloudinary images, with a signed-webhook payment simulator for development
Admin KPI dashboard and 8 reports with PDF and Excel export

projects.name: SportsSys — Intramurals Tournament System

image.alt: SportsSys admin dashboard with the referee live scorer, public live scores page and team registration form on mobile

projects.description: A system for running school intramurals. Sports coordinators set up tournaments and approve teams, referees score games live from their phones, and students follow live scores, brackets and standings.
highlights: Coordinator dashboard for users, teams and players, tournaments, schedules, bracketing, standings, announcements, messages and an audit log, with a step-by-step tournament setup wizard
Mobile live scorer for referees: per-quarter scoring with +1, +2 and +3 buttons, undo, end quarter and final-score submission
Public page with live scores, brackets, standings and upcoming matches, filtered by sport and by men's, women's and mixed divisions
Team registration with coach, adviser and a player roster by student ID; teams enter the bracket only after the organizer approves them
